name: Syzygy
source:
Deep in the mountains, three women suffer a chance meeting, and a ritual goes awry. Bound together by the results of their interrupted magic, they must work together and free themselves,  or fall victim to a curse of their own making.

[From [url=https://abnoctarium.itch.io/syzygy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在深山里，三个女人偶然相遇，仪式却出了岔子。他们被中断的魔法束缚在一起，必须共同努力并释放自己，否则就会成为自己制造的诅咒的受害者。

[来自[url=https://abnoctarium.itch.io/syzygy]itch.io[/url]]
